entities.summary: The Arktika class is a Russian class of nuclear-powered icebreakers. Also known by their Russian designations Project 10520 and Project 10521, they were the world's largest and most powerful icebreakers until the 2016 launch of the first Project 22220 icebreaker, also named Arktika.
